instructions_to_main_agent: Build the 45-second launch video runner / interactive storyboard player supporting both 9:16 Vertical Reel and 16:9 Landscape YouTube view modes.
Ensure interactive aspect ratio toggle switches smoothly between 9:16 and 16:9 modes with safezone boundary overlays.
Do NOT recolor original JEELIVE logo or exam tile artworks.
Ensure all interactive controls (play/pause, timestamp scrubber, format switcher, shot selector, sound toggle) have data-testid attributes.
DO NOT use fully transparent backgrounds for overlays or header bars; always use solid/semi-solid backgrounds (e.g., bg-black/70 with backdrop-blur).
Include real audio playback or animated SFX triggers corresponding to the timestamped storyboard beats.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.accessibility: Ensure text contrast ratio >= 4.5:1 (WCAG AA). Buttons must have explicit focus and hover states.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.testing_attributes: Add data-testid to all interactive components in kebab-case format (e.g. data-testid='format-toggle-9-16', data-testid='play-video-btn').
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.code_language: Use JavaScript / TypeScript React components (.js or .tsx files) matching existing repository structure.
